turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I'd like to know why my son's zero went in before anyone called me.
Owen talks about you in class, by the way.
Does he. I'm not here to discuss what Owen says in class. I'm here about the zero.
He's one of the kindest kids I teach. He walked a new student around the building all through September.
Kind isn't the question. Who decided on the zero, and why didn't anyone call me first?
A kid like that doesn't cheat out of malice. He was overwhelmed. We can both agree on that, right?
"Doesn't cheat out of malice." You just said that, Hale. I'm not agreeing to a word of it, and I haven't seen one document yet. What do you actually have?
